content.text:
Updated the package and README to match all ten sections of `SPEC.md`. The package review also fixed group ranking and tie-breaking, ordering and empty-group handling in per-group rates, and streaks that failed to reset on nonpositive counts.

Added regression tests confirming that `None` counts as a nonconversion and that the last occurrence of a duplicate ID wins, even when it has an earlier day.

Verified with `python -m pytest -q`: **18 tests passed**.
